tracks.title: Computer Science
tracks.description: Build foundations for reasoning about software and systems.

levels.title: Beginner
levels.objective: Explain an algorithm as a repeatable set of steps.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.objective: Compare time and space trade-offs in a small program.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.objective: Explain reliability and performance trade-offs in a design.

tracks.title: Economics
tracks.description: Practice core economic ideas with everyday examples.

levels.title: Beginner
levels.objective: Use opportunity cost to compare choices.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.objective: Explain how price elasticity describes a change in demand.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.objective: Analyze an externality and compare policy trade-offs.

tracks.title: Personal Finance
tracks.description: Learn general financial concepts for informed decisions.

levels.title: Beginner
levels.objective: Explain why people track income and expenses.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.objective: Compare borrowing costs using APR, fees, and timing.
